obligations.summary: Microenterprises (without partner or linked enterprises) may comply with certain quality management system elements under Article 17 in a simplified manner, as guided by Commission guidelines.
exceptions: Only applies to microenterprises within the meaning of Recommendation 2003/361/EC that do not have partner enterprises or linked enterprises within the meaning of that Recommendation.

obligations.summary: Microenterprises benefiting from simplified quality management system compliance must still fulfil all other requirements and obligations laid down in the Regulation, including those in Articles 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 72, and 73.
